items.title: Ex-Broncos exec John Beake, who helped land John Elway, dies at 87
items.text: John Beake, who was instrumental in the trade for John Elway and helped guide the Denver Broncos to back-to-back Super Bowl titles in the late 1990s, has died at age 87, the team said Saturday.

items.title: 49ers rule out Bosa for Monday, still hopeful for Evans, Juszczyk
items.text: The San Francisco 49ers will have to wait at least another week for the return of defensive end Nick Bosa, though there's at least a chance they'll have both receiver Mike Evans and fullback Kyle Juszczyk for Monday's game vs. the Washington Commanders.
